name: Sant Agustí de Lluçanès (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red saltire whose arms widen towards the corners, leaving yellow triangles at the hoist and fly, with a red pale between the upper and lower triangles.
history: Municipal flag of Sant Agustí de Lluçanès; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: saltire with broad arms leaving yellow triangles at the hoist and fly
pale joining the upper and lower red triangles
